from: After I had read the contract, I called the supplier.
frame: ___ the contract, I called the supplier.

ok.de: Richtig: Having read. Erst gelesen, dann angerufen: gleiches Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Having read. First read, then called: same subject.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Having muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Having must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach Having folgt die 3. Form: read, nicht reading.
wrong.en: After Having comes the past participle: read, not reading.

wrong.de: Having been read ist passiv. Du liest den Vertrag selbst: Having read.
wrong.en: Having been read is passive. You read the contract yourself: Having read.

from: The client released the funds after he had approved the final report.
frame: The client released the funds, ___ the final report.

ok.de: Richtig: having approved. Erst genehmigt, dann freigegeben.
ok.en: Right: having approved. First approved, then released.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort having muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word having must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach having folgt die 3. Form: approved, nicht approving.
wrong.en: After having comes the past participle: approved, not approving.

wrong.de: Having been approved ist passiv. Der Kunde genehmigt selbst: having approved.
wrong.en: Having been approved is passive. The client approves it himself: having approved.

prompt: Having wrote the proposal, she sent it to the board.
fixed: Having written the proposal, she sent it to the board.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Nach Having steht die 3. Form von write: written, nicht wrote.
ok.en: The error: after Having comes the past participle of write: written, not wrote.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Having passt wrote nicht.
wrong.en: There is an error: wrote does not fit after Having.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „wrote“: Nach Having braucht es die 3. Form.
wrong.en: The error is at “wrote”: after Having you need the past participle.

prompt: Having took the minutes, Lena shared them with the group.
fixed: Having taken the minutes, Lena shared them with the group.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Nach Having steht die 3. Form von take: taken, nicht took.
ok.en: The error: after Having comes the past participle of take: taken, not took.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Having passt took nicht.
wrong.en: There is an error: took does not fit after Having.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „took“: Nach Having braucht es die 3. Form.
wrong.en: The error is at “took”: after Having you need the past participle.

prompt: Having sent the quote on Monday, we are still waiting for an answer.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Having sent zeigt: Das Senden war zuerst fertig. Danach wartet man.
ok.en: No error: Having sent shows the sending came first. Waiting follows.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: Having + 3. Form (sent) passt, das Subjekt we gehört dazu.
wrong.en: No error: Having + past participle (sent) fits, and the subject we belongs to it.

a: Having left the office, Tom realized he had forgotten his badge.
b: Leaving the office, Tom realized he had forgotten his badge.

q.de: In welchem Satz hatte Tom das Büro schon verlassen, als er es merkte?
q.en: In which sentence had Tom already left the office when he noticed?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. Having left heißt: Tom ist schon draußen, dann merkt er es.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. Having left = already outside, noticed afterwards.

wrong.de: In b merkt Tom es beim Hinausgehen: Leaving läuft nur gleichzeitig.
wrong.en: In b Tom notices on his way out: Leaving happens at the same time.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: Having left ist abgeschlossen, Leaving läuft noch.
wrong.en: Not the same: Having left is finished, Leaving is still going on.

from: Because the team works with live data, it spots errors faster.
frame: ___ live data, the team spots errors faster.

ok.de: Richtig: Working with. Das Mittel, gleichzeitig: -ing statt Because.
ok.en: Right: Working with. The means, at the same time: -ing instead of Because.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Working muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Working must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Because gehört nicht in die Lücke: Das Partizip ersetzt den ganzen Nebensatz.
wrong.en: Because does not belong in the gap: the participle replaces the whole clause.

wrong.de: Being working ist keine Form. Das Partizip ist einfach Working.
wrong.en: Being working is not a form. The participle is simply Working.

from: As she walked to the station, Anna called her manager.
frame: ___ the station, Anna called her manager.

ok.de: Richtig: Walking to. Gleichzeitig: Anna ging und rief dabei an.
ok.en: Right: Walking to. At the same time: Anna walked and called while doing so.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Walking muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Walking must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: As she gehört nicht in die Lücke: Das Partizip ersetzt den Nebensatz.
wrong.en: As she does not belong in the gap: the participle replaces the clause.

wrong.de: Having walked hieße: erst gegangen. Hier ist beides gleichzeitig: Walking to.
wrong.en: Having walked means: walked first. Here both happen together: Walking to.

prompt: Used the new scanner, the clerk processed every invoice in minutes.
fixed: Using the new scanner, the clerk processed every invoice in minutes.

ok.de: Der Angestellte benutzt den Scanner selbst, also -ing: Using. Used passt nur, wenn mit dem Angestellten etwas gemacht wird.
ok.en: The clerk is using the scanner, so -ing: Using. Used only fits when something is done to the clerk.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Der Angestellte benutzt den Scanner selbst, also Using statt Used.
wrong.en: There is a mistake: the clerk is the one using the scanner, so Using, not Used.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „Used“: Der Angestellte tut es selbst, also -ing.
wrong.en: The mistake is in “Used”: the clerk is doing it, so -ing.

prompt: Open the file, the analyst found three formatting errors.
fixed: Opening the file, the analyst found three formatting errors.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Am Satzanfang braucht das Partizip -ing: Opening, nicht Open.
ok.en: The error: at the start the participle needs -ing: Opening, not Open.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Open wirkt wie ein Befehl, nicht wie ein Partizip.
wrong.en: There is an error: Open reads like a command, not like a participle.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „Open“: Ohne -ing ist es kein Partizip.
wrong.en: The error is at “Open”: without -ing it is not a participle.

a: Welcoming the guests, Sara handed out badges.
b: Welcomed by Sara, the guests received their badges.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt: Die Gäste wurden von Sara begrüßt?
q.en: Which sentence says the guests were welcomed by Sara?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz b. Welcomed by = Die Gäste werden begrüßt.
ok.en: Right: sentence b. Welcomed by = the guests receive the welcome.

wrong.de: In a begrüßt Sara selbst: -ing heißt, das Subjekt handelt.
wrong.en: In a Sara welcomes them herself: -ing means the subject acts.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: -ing = Subjekt handelt, 3. Form = Subjekt erlebt es.
wrong.en: Not the same: -ing = the subject acts, past participle = the subject receives it.

from: The product was designed for small teams, so it is easy to set up.
frame: ___ small teams, the product is easy to set up.

ok.de: Richtig: Designed for. Das Produkt wird entworfen: passiv, nur die 3. Form.
ok.en: Right: Designed for. The product is designed: passive, just the past participle.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Designed muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Designed must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Designing hieße: Das Produkt entwirft selbst. Es wird entworfen: Designed.
wrong.en: Designing would mean the product designs. It is designed: Designed.

wrong.de: Was designed ist ein finiter Satzteil. Das Partizip steht allein: Designed for.
wrong.en: Was designed is a finite verb phrase. The participle stands alone: Designed for.

from: As the offer was based on old figures, it was rejected.
frame: ___ old figures, the offer was rejected.

ok.de: Richtig: Based on. Das Angebot beruht auf alten Zahlen: passiv, nur die 3. Form.
ok.en: Right: Based on. The offer rests on old figures: passive, just the past participle.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Based muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Based must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Basing hieße: Das Angebot gründet selbst etwas. Es beruht auf Zahlen: Based.
wrong.en: Basing would mean the offer bases something. It rests on figures: Based.

wrong.de: As gehört nicht in die Lücke: Das Partizip ersetzt den ganzen Nebensatz.
wrong.en: As does not belong in the gap: the participle replaces the whole clause.

prompt: Writing in plain English, the manual is easy to follow.
fixed: Written in plain English, the manual is easy to follow.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Das Handbuch wird geschrieben, es schreibt nicht: Written, nicht Writing.
ok.en: The error: the manual is written, it does not write: Written, not Writing.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Writing passt nicht zum passiven Sinn.
wrong.en: There is an error: Writing does not fit the passive meaning.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „Writing“: Das Handbuch schreibt nicht selbst.
wrong.en: The error is at “Writing”: the manual does not write itself.

prompt: Delaying by the storm, the flight arrived two hours late.
fixed: Delayed by the storm, the flight arrived two hours late.

ok.de: Der Fehler: Der Flug wird verspätet, er verspätet nichts: Delayed by, nicht Delaying by.
ok.en: The error: the flight is delayed, it delays nothing: Delayed by, not Delaying by.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Delaying by passt nicht zum passiven Sinn.
wrong.en: There is an error: Delaying by does not fit the passive meaning.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „Delaying by“: Der Flug erlebt die Verspätung.
wrong.en: The error is at “Delaying by”: the flight receives the delay.

prompt: Located in the city center, the office is close to the station.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Located in = Das Büro liegt dort. Passiver Sinn, nur die 3. Form.
ok.en: No error: Located in = the office lies there. Passive meaning, just the past participle.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: Located passt, denn das Büro wird irgendwo platziert, es platziert nichts.
wrong.en: No error: Located fits, because the office is placed somewhere and places nothing.

a: Called by the client, Mia left the meeting early.
b: Calling the client, Mia left the meeting early.

q.de: In welchem Satz hat der Kunde angerufen?
q.en: In which sentence did the client make the call?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. Called by = Der Kunde ruft Mia an.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. Called by = the client calls Mia.

wrong.de: In b ruft Mia selbst an: -ing heißt, das Subjekt handelt.
wrong.en: In b Mia makes the call herself: -ing means the subject acts.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: 3. Form = Subjekt erlebt es, -ing = Subjekt tut es.
wrong.en: Not the same: past participle = the subject receives it, -ing = the subject does it.

from: As I was waiting for my flight, I met an old classmate.
frame: ___ my flight, I met an old classmate.

ok.de: Richtig: Waiting for. Ich warte und ich treffe: dasselbe Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Waiting for. I wait and I meet: the same subject.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Waiting muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Waiting must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: As I was gehört nicht in die Lücke: Das Partizip ersetzt den Nebensatz.
wrong.en: As I was does not belong in the gap: the participle replaces the clause.

wrong.de: Waited for ist die einfache Vergangenheit und ersetzt keinen Nebensatz.
wrong.en: Waited for is the simple past and does not replace a clause.

from: Because I had checked the figures twice, I was sure of the result.
frame: ___ the figures twice, I was sure of the result.

ok.de: Richtig: Having checked. Ich prüfe und ich bin sicher: dasselbe Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Having checked. I check and I am sure: the same subject.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort Having muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word Having must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach Having folgt die 3. Form: checked, nicht checking.
wrong.en: After Having comes the past participle: checked, not checking.

wrong.de: Having been checked ist passiv. Hier prüfst du selbst: Having checked.
wrong.en: Having been checked is passive. Here you check yourself: Having checked.

prompt: Walking to work, my phone rang twice.
answer: While I was walking to work,
fixed: While I was walking to work, my phone rang twice.
accepted: When I was walking to work,
As I was walking to work,

ok.de: Der Fehler: Dein Telefon geht nicht zur Arbeit. Das Partizip braucht ein passendes Subjekt.
ok.en: The error: your phone does not walk to work. The participle needs a matching subject.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Walking gehört nicht zu my phone.
wrong.en: There is an error: Walking does not belong to my phone.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt am Anfang: Wer geht zur Arbeit? Nicht das Telefon.
wrong.en: The error is at the start: who walks to work? Not the phone.

prompt: Reading the report, the figures seemed wrong to me.
fixed: When I read the report, the figures seemed wrong to me.
accepted: While I was reading the report,

ok.de: Der Fehler: Die Zahlen lesen den Bericht nicht. Das Partizip braucht ein passendes Subjekt.
ok.en: The error: the figures do not read the report. The participle needs a matching subject.

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Reading gehört nicht zu the figures.
wrong.en: There is an error: Reading does not belong to the figures.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt am Anfang: Wer liest den Bericht? Nicht die Zahlen.
wrong.en: The error is at the start: who reads the report? Not the figures.

prompt: Reading the minutes, I noticed two missing names.

ok.de: Kein Fehler: Ich lese und ich bemerke: Das Partizip passt zum Subjekt I.
ok.en: No error: I read and I notice: the participle fits the subject I.

wrong.de: Kein Fehler: Reading gehört zu I, dem Subjekt nach dem Komma.
wrong.en: No error: Reading belongs to I, the subject after the comma.

a: Having read the report, the manager spoke to the client.
b: The manager spoke to the client who had read the report.

q.de: In welchem Satz hat der Kunde den Bericht gelesen?
q.en: In which sentence did the client read the report?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz b. Der Relativsatz gehört zum Kunden, das Partizip zum Manager.
ok.en: Right: sentence b. The relative clause belongs to the client, the participle to the manager.

wrong.de: In a gehört Having read zum Manager (Subjekt): Er hat den Bericht gelesen.
wrong.en: In a Having read belongs to the manager (the subject): he did the reading.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich: Das Partizip bezieht sich aufs Subjekt, der Relativsatz auf den Kunden.
wrong.en: Not the same: the participle refers to the subject, the relative clause to the client.
